items.title: Germaine Bazzle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: I was blessed to be a part of a group with Alvin “Red” Tyler

ctx.x: You know the astute listener and watcher will even see that happen, see you walk over and hum something and then I mean that’s great.

Yes it is. And I was blessed to be a part of a group with Alvin “Red” Tyler who is a great, wonderful musician in New Orleans. And I learned a lot from him. Sometimes we were on the gig and he’d play a little riff and he’d look at me. It was no words. He’d just play this little riff and he’d look at me and I’d say okay here we go [scats] and I’m trying to find a third or something to do it with him in thirds. And that’s — I learned that from him. I learned a lot from him. But that’s one of the little secrets. And…
Was music part of your life from a young age?
